**How to submit:** Write on paper or in a document. Upload a clear photo or a PDF to the university e-learning platform. Due: **before lecture 5**.
You may use AI where a task says so. Check its work and say how you used it.

A studio writes *Last Light*, a game about Yusuf, an old lighthouse keeper.
Here is a part of its script:

> INT. LIGHTHOUSE – NIGHT
>
> Wind shakes the windows. The big lamp is dark. YUSUF (70) climbs the
> stairs with a candle.
>
> YUSUF\
> (out of breath)\
> One more step, old man.

## Task 1 · The parts of the page (2 marks)

Write the name of each part of the script above: **scene heading**,
**action line**, **character**, **parenthetical** or **dialogue**.
a) INT. LIGHTHOUSE – NIGHT · b) Wind shakes the windows. The big lamp is
dark. · c) (out of breath) · d) One more step, old man.

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

## Task 2 · A better line and two barks (2 marks)

a) In the first draft, Yusuf says: "As you know, the lamp is broken, and I am
very worried about the ships." Rewrite this line so that it is short, has no
"as you know", and shows the worry instead of naming it. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) In the game, the player helps Yusuf repair the lamp. Write two barks for
Yusuf, each with its trigger. (1 mark)
